Method of Attack: ultrasound cross-device tracking (uXDT) via hidden ultrasounds in ads or JavaScript code that cause devices to emit ultrasounds and send identity beacons to advertisers, enabling deanonymization of Tor users
Discoverer: Vasilios Mavroudis and team of six researchers
Impacted Systems: phones and computers with apps embedding advertising SDKs supporting uXDT
Attack Vector: web pages with ads emitting ultrasounds
hidden JavaScript code using HTML5 Audio API
malicious Tor exit nodes performing Man-in-the-Middle attacks
ultrasounds hidden inside videos or audio files
Indicators of Compromise: ultrasound beacons triggering network traffic containing real IP address, geo-location coordinates, telephone number, Android ID, IMEI code, device MAC address
